svg.data-weight-note: Table 98 (physical specifications) of the MX2008 hardware guide gives 261 lb (118.39 kg) for the chassis with components removed. It gives 742.2 lb (336.66 kg) for the AC chassis with maximum configuration. The DC chassis at maximum is 664.8 lb (301.55 kg). The chassis with midplane and air filters only is 235.5 lb (106.82 kg). The kilogram figures are the table's own.
svg.data-power-typical-scope: base system excluding MPCs, ADCs and MICs, at 25 C (Table 25); side not named
svg.data-power-max-scope: base system excluding MPCs, ADCs and MICs, at 55 C (Table 25); side not named
